name: declared_pins stops stripping quotes, so '3.12' never matches a bare 3.12
expect: a declared pin is read, quotes stripped

name: job_names runs past the jobs block, so a later top-level key reads as a job
edits:
if line and not line.startswith(" ") and not line.startswith("#"):
                break
expect: ...and a top-level key after jobs ends the block

name: job_blocks stops splitting, so a pin in ONE job is credited to its sibling
edits: end = ordered[idx + 1][1] if idx + 1 < len(ordered) else len(lines)
expect: a pin in a SIBLING job does not cover its neighbour

name: unpinned_jobs stops honouring the exemption list
expect: ...and an exempt job is not reported either

name: running_version drops the minor, so 3.12 and 3.14 look identical
the empty-corpus refusal goes, so a missing workflow dir reads as a pass
expect: no workflows at all is CANNOT RUN, never a pass

name: the no-pin-anywhere refusal goes — the precise state this guard exists to end
edits: return 2, ("CANNOT RUN — no `python-version:` was found in any workflow
return 0, ("CANNOT RUN — no `python-version:` was found in any workflow
expect: ...and so is a corpus with no pin anywhere

name: disagreeing pins stop failing, so guards and gates can run different interpreters
an unpinned job stops failing, which is the whole subject of this guard
the CI assertion goes, so a setup-python step that did NOT take effect reports green
expect: IN CI a mismatch FAILS, because it means the pin did not take effect

name: the local advisory becomes a FAILURE, which is how a gate gets switched off
expect: ...but LOCALLY the same mismatch is ADVISORY and exits 0
